tasks.label: ROMS dependency audit summary
args: const fs=require('fs');const cp=require('child_process');for(const root of ['.','server']){let output;try{output=cp.execSync('npm --prefix '+root+' audit --json',{encoding:'utf8'});}catch(error){output=error.stdout;}const report=JSON.parse(output);const lock=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(root+'/package-lock.json','utf8'));console.log(root,JSON.stringify(report.metadata.vulnerabilities));for(const [name,item] of Object.entries(report.vulnerabilities||{}))console.log(name+'@'+(lock.packages['node_modules/'+name]?.version||'?'),item.severity,JSON.stringify(item.fixAvailable));}

tasks.label: ROMS blueprint link validation
args: const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');const files=['docs/system-blueprint.md','.github/modernize/assessment/engines/facts/architecture-diagram.md','docs/business-workflows.md','docs/node-postgres-deployment.md'];for(const file of files){const text=fs.readFileSync(file,'utf8');for(const match of text.matchAll(/\]\(([^)]+)\)/g)){const target=match[1].split('#')[0];if(!target||/^[a-z]+:/i.test(target))continue;if(!fs.existsSync(path.resolve(path.dirname(file),target)))throw new Error('Broken link '+file+' -> '+target);}console.log('LINKS OK '+file);}
